Here is a comprehensive overview of the **2012 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election**:

---

### **Summary**
The 2012 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on **3 May 2012**, as part of the wider local elections across England that year. In this election, one-third of the seats (21 of 63) on the council were contested.

---

### **Key Features**
- **Location:** Stockport, Greater Manchester, England
- **Date:** 3 May 2012
- **Seats for Election:** 21 out of 63
- **Council Composition Before Election:** Led by the Liberal Democrats, who had been the majority party since 2002.

---

### **Main Political Parties and Results**
The main parties contesting were:
- Liberal Democrats (LD)
- Labour Party (Lab)
- Conservative Party (Con)
- Heald Green Ratepayers (local independent group)

#### **Key Results:**
- The **Liberal Democrats** lost their majority and the council moved to **No Overall Control (NOC)**. 
- **Labour** made notable gains.
- **Conservatives** held steady, with some losses.
- **Heald Green Ratepayers** maintained their usual single-seat stronghold.

#### **Council composition after the election:**
- **Liberal Democrats:** 28 seats (down from 31)
- **Labour:** 21 seats (up from 16)
- **Conservatives:** 10 seats (down from 11)
- **Heald Green Ratepayers:** 3 seats (unchanged)
- **Others / Independents:** 1 seat

**A majority in the council requires 32 seats. No party reached this mark.**

---

### **Significance**
- The loss of majority for the Liberal Democrats reflected a challenging period for the party nationally, coinciding with their participation in the Conservative-led coalition government.
- Labour's increasing popularity was seen both locally and nationally at this time.
- Council leadership often requires forming coalitions or arrangements in NOC scenarios.

---

### **Ward results**
Election was held in these wards (among others):
- Bramhall North                  
- Bramhall South and Woodford
- Bredbury & Woodley
- Bredbury Green & Romiley
- Brinnington & Central
- Cheadle 
- Cheadle Hulme North
- Cheadle Hulme South
- Davenport & Cale Green
- Edgeley & Cheadle Heath
- Hazel Grove
- Heald Green
- Heatons North
- Heatons South
- Manor
- Marple North
- Marple South
- Offerton
- Reddish North
- Reddish South
- Stepping Hill

Each ward elected one councillor (as one-third of seats were contested).

---

### **Turnout**
The average turnout was slightly above or close to the national average for local elections, generally around **30-33%**, though precise figures vary by ward.

---

### **References & Resources**
- **BBC News:** [Local council election results 2012](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/special/vote2012/council/E08000007.stm)
- **Stockport Council official website** (archived results for more detail)
- **Wikipedia article:** ["2012 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2012_Stockport_Metropolitan_Borough_Council_election)

---
